description: This Java class defines the RuleNode entity used in the Thingsboard platform, including its properties, constructors, and annotations for serialization, validation, and documentation.

classes.name: RuleNode
classes.description: Represents a rule node in the Thingsboard rule engine, including properties for configuration, debug settings, and identification.

methods.name: RuleNode(RuleNodeId id)
methods.description: Constructor initializing RuleNode with a specific ID.

methods.name: RuleNode(RuleNode ruleNode)
methods.description: Copy constructor for creating a new RuleNode from an existing one.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the rule node.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the rule node.

methods.name: getCreatedTime
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the rule node.

methods.name: getAdditionalInfo
methods.description: Returns additional parameters for visualization and description.

methods.name: isDebugMode
methods.description: Returns the debug mode status (ignored for serialization).

methods.name: setDebugMode
methods.description: Sets the debug mode status (used during deserialization).
